text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a research article focused on developing and applying an ecosystem-based index of ecological integrity (IEI) and an index of ecological impact (ecoImpact) for landscape conservation assessment. While it includes a land use change scenario modeling component (urban growth projections), the primary focus is on ecological integrity assessment and conservation planning rather than on national-scale land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. The scenario modeling is regional (northeastern United States), not national-scale, and the LULC projection component is not the central research question but rather an application of the ecological integrity indices. Moreover, there is no indication that the paper implements multiple future scenarios with quantitative accuracy metrics at the national scale. Therefore, it does not meet the core inclusion criteria for national-scale LULC prediction studies.)
